resources.string: Stop RikkaHub from auto-writing built-in providers, and allow deleting them

Version %1$s
What it does 1. No more auto-written built-in providers Every time RikkaHub loads or saves its settings it re-adds any missing entry of DEFAULT_PROVIDERS, so a provider you deleted comes back. The module drops those re-added entries: only providers you saved yourself survive.
2. Built-in providers become deletable The builtIn flag is cleared to false, so the delete button in the provider settings shows up and actually sticks.
How to use 1. Enable this module in LSPosed (or any other Xposed framework). 2. Tick RikkaHub in the module scope, package name me.rerere.rikkahub. 3. Force-stop RikkaHub, then open it again.
How to verify - RikkaHub > Settings > Providers: only your own providers remain, built-in ones can be deleted. - Logs: open the LSPosed log page and filter for RikkaHubNoSPON; you will see lines like "providers N -> M".
Notes - The filter keeps a provider when its id was present in the input of normalized(), so providers you add by hand or restore from a backup are kept. - Hooks are installed by class/method name and were verified against RikkaHub 3.3.0. A major host rewrite may break them; failures are only logged and never harm the host app. - TTS, ASR and media-generation providers are out of scope. - Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
